_note: Tourist entry rules for ordinary Indian passport holders, read on each country's official page (immigration, foreign ministry, official e-visa portal, or its embassy) on the 'checked' date. status: visa-free, visa-on-arrival, e-visa, visa-needed, or check (could not confirm on an official page: no stay or fee shown). Fees only where the official page states them. India's MEA list (mea.gov.in/vffin) is used only as a pointer on 'check' rows. Rules change often: recheck every 2-3 months, and Malaysia before 1 Jan 2027.

countries.name: Thailand
conditions: For tourism. The 30-day exemption for Indians started on 15 Sep 2026 (it was 60 days before).
Fill in the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) online in the 3 days before you arrive.
Staying longer than 30 days? Apply for a Thai e-visa before you go.
countries.say: Yes, for tourism: since 15 September 2026 Indian passport holders can stay up to 30 days without a visa (it was 60 days before), says the Royal Thai Embassy in New Delhi. Fill in the online Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) before you land. For longer stays, apply for an e-visa.

countries.name: UAE
conditions: The UAE is not visa-free for Indians, and its visa on arrival is only for the visa and residence holders below.
Everyone else needs a UAE visit visa before the flight. GDRFA Dubai and ICP list the visit visas and how to apply.
countries.with_visa: GDRFA Dubai gives a 14-day visa on arrival (extendable once by 14 days) to Indians with a US green card or a UK or EU residence visa, applied for online first. The page does not name a US visit visa, so check before you fly.
countries.say: Most Indians do. The UAE's visa on arrival for Indians is only for those holding a US green card or a UK or EU residence visa (14 days, extendable once), says GDRFA Dubai. Everyone else needs a UAE visit visa before the flight.

sources.label: GDRFA Dubai: visa on arrival for Indians

countries.name: Singapore
countries.fee: ₹2,100 visa fee (the agent may charge its own fee)
conditions: Apply through an authorised visa agent in India. There is no visa on arrival.
Passport valid for at least 6 months from the day you arrive.
Form 14A and photos.
countries.with_visa: Changing planes? Indians may qualify for 96-hour visa-free transit if they hold a valid visa or long-term pass from one of the countries Singapore lists, plus an onward ticket.
countries.say: Yes. Indian passport holders need a visa for Singapore, applied for through an authorised visa agent in India. The visa fee is ₹2,100 per application, says Singapore's High Commission in New Delhi, and your passport needs 6 months' validity.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.until: 31 Dec 2026. Travelling from 1 Jan 2027? Check Malaysia's immigration site before you book: the exemption may not be extended.
conditions: Social visits only (holiday, family), not work or study.
Malaysia's immigration site links to the online Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC): fill it in before you arrive.
countries.say: Yes, until 31 December 2026: Malaysia's immigration department exempts Indian nationals from the visa for social visits, for up to 30 days. For trips from 1 January 2027, check Malaysia's official visa site before you book, because the exemption has an end date.

countries.name: Indonesia
conditions: Get it on arrival or online before you fly (e-VOA) on Indonesia's official immigration site.
Passport valid for at least 6 months.
Return or onward ticket.
countries.say: Indians get a visa on arrival (also available online as an e-VOA) for 30 days, extendable once, for IDR 500,000, says Indonesia's immigration department. Carry a passport valid for 6 months and a return ticket.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.aka: Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang
conditions: Apply online before you travel, only on Vietnam's official e-visa portal.
Single or multiple entry.
Vietnam's visa exemption for India covers only diplomatic and official passports, not ordinary ones.
countries.say: No. Ordinary Indian passport holders need a Vietnam e-visa, valid for up to 90 days with single or multiple entry, applied for on Vietnam's official e-visa portal. Only Indian diplomatic and official passports are visa-exempt.

countries.name: Sri Lanka
conditions: Apply for the ETA online before you arrive, on Sri Lanka's official ETA site.
Staying longer than 30 days? Pay for an extension in Sri Lanka.
countries.say: You need an ETA (electronic travel authorisation), but for Indians it is free: 30 days with double entry, says Sri Lanka's official ETA site. Apply online before you fly.

countries.name: Maldives
countries.stay: Given on arrival (the official page gives no number)
conditions: Passport valid for at least 1 month, with a machine-readable zone.
Confirmed return ticket and a paid booking at a registered hotel or resort.
Enough money for your stay.
Each traveller, including children, files the free IMUGA Traveller Declaration up to 96 hours before arrival.
countries.say: Indians get a tourist visa on arrival in the Maldives. Maldives Immigration asks for a return ticket, a paid hotel or resort booking, enough money and the free online Traveller Declaration, filed up to 96 hours before you land.

countries.name: Nepal
conditions: Flying: only a valid Indian passport or an original Voter ID card is accepted.
Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence or a printed Voter ID are not accepted for flights.
countries.say: Indians need no visa for Nepal. When flying, carry a valid Indian passport or your original Voter ID card: the Embassy of India in Kathmandu says these are the only two documents accepted, so Aadhaar or PAN won't do.

sources.label: Embassy of India, Kathmandu: valid documents
India MEA: visa facility for Indians

countries.name: Bhutan
conditions: No visa, but you need an entry permit, at Paro airport or the road border offices.
Indian passport valid for 6 months, or your original Voter ID.
Children without a passport: original birth certificate.
countries.say: Indians need no visa for Bhutan, but they need an entry permit and pay a Sustainable Development Fee of ₹1,200 per night. Carry a passport valid for 6 months or your original Voter ID, says the Embassy of India in Thimphu.

countries.name: Mauritius
countries.stay: Set by the officer at the airport (tourists: up to 6 months a year, case by case)
conditions: Passport valid beyond your stay, a return ticket, enough money, and a confirmed hotel booking or a sponsor.
Fill in the free Mauritius All-in-One Travel Digital Form online before you fly; airlines ask for proof at boarding.
The immigration officer decides how long you can stay.
countries.say: No visa is needed: Mauritius's Passport and Immigration Office lists India as "No visa required". Carry a return ticket, a hotel booking and enough money, and fill in the free All-in-One Travel Digital Form before you fly.

sources.label: Mauritius Passport and Immigration Office: country-wise visa list
Mauritius Passport and Immigration Office: travel requirements

countries.name: Seychelles
countries.fee: Visitor's permit free for 3 months; Travel Authorisation fee not stated
conditions: Apply for the Seychelles Travel Authorisation online before you leave.
Return or onward ticket, confirmed accommodation and enough money.
countries.say: No visa is needed: you get a free visitor's permit on arrival for up to 3 months, but you must get a Seychelles Travel Authorisation online before you leave, says Seychelles Immigration.

countries.name: Hong Kong
conditions: Register online first (pre-arrival registration, PAR). It is valid for 6 months and several visits.
Passport valid for at least 6 months.
Print the notification slip and carry it.
countries.say: Indians can visit Hong Kong without a visa for up to 14 days, but only after a free online pre-arrival registration, valid for 6 months, says Hong Kong's Immigration Department.

countries.name: Japan
countries.fee: ₹500 visa fee for Indians from 1 July 2026, plus the VFS service fee
conditions: Japan's eVISA has run in India since 1 April 2024. Submit your application through VFS.
Applications open 3 months before travel. Plan well ahead.
countries.say: Indians need a visa for Japan. Since 1 April 2024 it can be a JAPAN eVISA, applied for through VFS, says the Embassy of Japan in India.

sources.label: Embassy of Japan in India: visa

countries.name: South Korea
conditions: Apply for a Korean visa through the Korea Visa Portal (visa.go.kr), with in-person submission at the application centre.
countries.say: Yes. The Korean Consulate in Chennai says Indian nationals must apply for a Korean visa through the Korea Visa Portal.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.stay: Up to 30 days on the e-visa
conditions: Without a qualifying visa, apply for a sticker visa at a Turkish mission in India.
countries.with_visa: With a valid US, UK, Schengen or Irish visa or residence permit, Indians can get a single-entry e-visa, valid for one month, for tourism or business.
countries.say: Most Indians need a visa from a Turkish mission. With a valid US, UK, Schengen or Irish visa or residence permit, you can get a single-entry e-visa for up to a month instead, says Turkey's foreign ministry.

countries.name: Georgia
countries.stay: Short stays under 90 days, as on the e-visa
conditions: Apply on Georgia's official e-visa portal.
Passport valid at least 3 months beyond the visa.
Return ticket, travel insurance, money and a hotel booking.
countries.with_visa: With a valid visa or residence permit of the US, UK, an EU or Schengen country or another listed country, Indians can stay up to 90 days in any 180 without a Georgian visa.
countries.say: Indians can apply for a Georgian e-visa on the official portal, for short stays under 90 days. With a valid US, UK, EU or Schengen visa or residence permit, no Georgian visa is needed for up to 90 days in 180 (Government Ordinance No. 256).

countries.name: Azerbaijan
conditions: Apply on Azerbaijan's official ASAN e-visa portal: standard in 3 working days, urgent in 3 hours.
Passport valid at least 3 months beyond the e-visa.
Staying over 15 days: register with the State Migration Service.
countries.say: Indians can apply for an Azerbaijan e-visa on the official ASAN Visa portal. It allows one entry and a stay of up to 30 days, within 90 days of validity.

countries.name: Kazakhstan
countries.stay: 14 days at a time, 42 days in any 180
conditions: For tourism, business or private visits.
countries.say: Yes: Indians can stay in Kazakhstan without a visa for up to 14 days at a time, and 42 days in any 180, say Kazakhstan's embassy in New Delhi and India's embassy in Astana.

countries.name: Qatar
conditions: India's MEA lists a free visa on arrival for Indians, with the stay set by a hotel booking on the Discover Qatar website. We could not confirm this on a Qatari government page.
countries.say: India's MEA lists a visa on arrival, but we could not confirm it on Qatar's own pages. Check Visit Qatar's visa checker or Qatar's embassy in New Delhi.

sources.label: India MEA: visa facility for Indians

countries.name: Oman
conditions: Apply online for the Tourist Visit Visa (Unsponsored) on the Royal Oman Police e-visa site.
Passport valid for 6 months, return ticket, hotel booking, health insurance and enough money.
countries.with_visa: With a GCC residence permit, or a valid visa for the US, Canada, Australia, the UK, a Schengen country or Japan, Indians can stay 14 days without a visa (not extendable).
countries.say: Indians with a GCC residence or a valid US, Canadian, Australian, UK, Schengen or Japanese visa can stay 14 days visa-free; others apply for an e-visa, says Oman's foreign ministry.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.fee: US$30 single entry, US$65 multiple entry
conditions: Apply on Egypt's official e-visa portal.
Passport valid for at least 6 months from arrival.
Hotel bookings and travel plan.
countries.say: Indians can apply for an Egypt e-visa on the official portal: US$30 single entry or US$65 multiple entry.

countries.name: Kenya
conditions: Every visitor, including children, needs an approved Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) before travel.
Passport valid for 6 months with a blank page.
Travel plan and hotel booking.
countries.say: Yes, Indians need Kenya's eTA before they travel. The standard eTA costs US$30, says Kenya's official eTA site.

countries.name: United Kingdom
conditions: Standard Visitor visa, applied for online up to 3 months before travel.
Indians can't use the UK ETA.
Show you can pay for your trip and will leave at the end.
countries.say: Yes. Indians need a UK Standard Visitor visa (£135 for up to 6 months, says GOV.UK). The UK's ETA is not open to Indian passport holders.

sources.label: GOV.UK: who can get an ETA

countries.name: Schengen countries
countries.aka: Europe, France, Germany, Italy, Switzerland, Spain, Netherlands, Greece
conditions: Schengen short-stay (C) visa, with fingerprints at a visa centre (children under 12 exempt).
Passport valid at least 3 months after you leave, issued in the last 10 years, with 2 blank pages.
Proof of enough money for your stay.
countries.say: Indians need a Schengen visa for France, Germany, Italy, Switzerland and the other Schengen countries: up to 90 days in any 180, €90 for adults (EU home affairs), with fingerprints at a visa centre.

sources.label: German Missions in India: Schengen visa FAQ

countries.name: United States
countries.stay: Set by the officer when you arrive
conditions: B-1/B-2 visitor visa: form DS-160, then an interview at a US embassy or consulate in India.
India is not in the Visa Waiver Program.
countries.say: Yes. Indians need a US visitor visa (B-1/B-2); the application fee is US$185, says the US State Department. India is not in the Visa Waiver Program.

sources.label: US State Dept: Visa Waiver Program

countries.name: Canada
countries.stay: Usually up to 6 months (the border officer decides)
conditions: Visitor visa with biometrics.
A US visa does not let Indians use Canada's eTA instead: India is not on that list.
Passport should be valid for 6 months.
countries.say: Yes. Indians need a Canadian visitor visa: CAN$100 plus CAN$85 for biometrics, says IRCC. Holding a US visa does not let Indians use an eTA instead.

sources.label: Canada: apply for a visitor visa
Canada: eTA for some visa-required countries

countries.name: Australia
conditions: Visitor visa (subclass 600), tourist stream, applied for online before you travel.
countries.say: Yes. Indians apply for Australia's Visitor visa (subclass 600) before they travel: from AUD 250, for a stay of up to 12 months, says Australia's Department of Home Affairs.

countries.name: New Zealand
conditions: Immigration New Zealand's Visitor Visa page has a checklist for visitors from India (stays of less than 6 months) and says a Visitor Visa allows a stay of up to 9 months in any 18-month period at most, as decided on your application. That page does not say in plain words whether Indian passport holders need a visa or may use an NZeTA, so we have not marked the rule as confirmed. Check before you plan.
countries.say: Immigration New Zealand's Visitor Visa page has a checklist for Indian applicants, but we could not confirm in plain words whether Indians need a visa or an NZeTA. Check its Visitor Visa page before you plan.
